runner: run_simpler_env.py: the loop of SimplerEnv's run_maniskill2_eval_single_episode over the official episode list
note: MolmoAct-7B-D-Pretrain-RT-1 (Google Robot) with vLLM, the inference path the MolmoAct README replicates its results with (allenai/SimplerEnv MolmoActInferenceVLLM: bf16, greedy, max 256 new tokens, 256x256 image, fractal statistics, sticky gripper 15). vLLM 0.9.2 (CUDA 12.8 build, V0 engine, envs/molmoact-vllm) instead of the pinned 0.8.5, which has no RTX 5090 kernels; one fix for >=0.9 (no llm_config -> text_config rename). scripts/molmoact_vllm_server.py batches the queries of 8 SimplerEnv workers (up to 16 per batch); measured 0.39 s per query at batch 8 vs 3.5 s for one Hugging Face query. Batched and single queries can decode differently, as vLLM and Hugging Face already do. Official SimplerEnv episodes (VM + VA, also put-in-drawer, which MolmoAct's scripts leave out); this job takes shards 8-15 of 16, its twin the rest.
